name: Li Andersson-Commission proposal
title: Guidelines for the employment policies of the Member States
part_text:
The European Parliament wants the European Union's yearly employment guidelines to put quality jobs and decent working conditions first. It asks for fair wages, stronger collective bargaining, better protection for workers, and more support for training and skills. It also wants action on housing, poverty, care, disability rights and help for people fleeing Ukraine. Parliament is only giving its opinion here; the Council of the European Union makes the final decision, and Parliament asks to be told if the Council changes the text.

- **What changes:** The guidelines would add fair wages, collective bargaining, training rights and housing support.
- **Who it affects:** Workers, jobseekers, young people, people with disabilities, carers and migrants across the EU.
- **What happens next:** The Council decides; Parliament asks to be consulted again if the text changes substantially.
